name: matrix_feedback
description: Edit only task_definition using its parent whole-prompt confusion matrix.
both: Edit the description of the classification task and input. Preserve the task goal; do not invent label criteria or include decision instructions, examples, or output wrappers. Feedback describes the whole parent combination, not this component alone. It cannot identify which component caused errors; treat edits as hypotheses. Consider row totals when interpreting error counts. Combine the two target components, then mutate the combination. Return exactly {"crossover": VALUE, "value": VALUE}.
crossover_only: Edit the description of the classification task and input. Preserve the task goal; do not invent label criteria or include decision instructions, examples, or output wrappers. Feedback describes the whole parent combination, not this component alone. It cannot identify which component caused errors; treat edits as hypotheses. Consider row totals when interpreting error counts. Combine the two target components without a separate mutation. Return exactly {"crossover": VALUE}.
mutation_only: Edit the description of the classification task and input. Preserve the task goal; do not invent label criteria or include decision instructions, examples, or output wrappers. Feedback describes the whole parent combination, not this component alone. It cannot identify which component caused errors; treat edits as hypotheses. Consider row totals when interpreting error counts. Mutate only the supplied first-parent target component. Return exactly {"value": VALUE}.
